changes.comment: GenUX live tool refresh (#1297): when a workspace's promoted-component set changes (component_promote/demote, or a promoted component edited), the co-located MCP server pushes notifications/tools/list_changed to that workspace's live sessions so dynamic render_<name> tools refresh without the agent re-listing. Adds a `component.changed` domain event emitted by the registry handlers, retains per-session MCP Server instances, and declares the tools.listChanged capability. Broker-mode only.
